components.name: AiChatBubble
components.description:
Figma AI/Chat-Bubble (4218:1270): You = a Neutral/Subtle bubble (radius 24, padding 12/16, right-aligned, max 560);
AI = plain Body/Extra/Regular text across the column. Both use Body/Extra/Regular; actions appear under the bubble on hover.

props.name: actions
props.description: Figma Items slot: actions shown on hover / focus (You: copy · edit; AI: like · dislike · regenerate · copy).

props.name: version
props.description: AI: which answer version is shown ("1/2"), next to the actions.

props.name: streaming
props.description: AI: the reply is still streaming (a pulsing caret follows the text).

props.name: thinking
props.description: AI: the assistant is working and no text has arrived yet — three dots in a looping wave. Also shown when `streaming` has no content yet.

props.name: thinkingLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the thinking indicator (the locale's "Thinking" by default).

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the action buttons the bubble draws, by layer (`Button`, `Button[1]` when there
 are several). Written by Zen Studio; app code sets `actions`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>` element.

components.name: AiChatField
components.description:
Figma AI/Chat-Field (12074:16888): radius 32, padding 12; one row (+ · prompt Body/Extra/Medium · model · mic · Primary
40px) that becomes two rows for long prompts (State=Long-Typing). The Primary action is Voice (recording) when empty and
Send (arrow-up) once there is text. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; Tab also calls `onAccept` (keep the guessed
intent) and still moves focus, Escape clears only with `onClear`. The whole field is the prompt's hit area: a
click or tap anywhere outside its buttons puts the caret in the prompt. The +, the microphone and Voice appear only with
their handler (`onAttach`, `onVoice` / `onVoiceMode`), so the field never shows a button that does nothing. State=Voice (15114:219):
`listening` shows Listening… and turns the microphone into Stop.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Prompt placeholder, also the field's accessible name (the locale's "Ask me anything" by default).

props.name: model
props.description: Figma Model: the model switch label (Body/Base/Medium + chevron) — open your model Popover from `onModelClick`.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Figma Leading-Actions (+): attachments or tools. Without it the + is not drawn (it would do nothing).

props.name: onVoice
props.description:
Figma trailing microphone (Icon-Flat): dictation into the prompt. Also the empty field's Voice action unless
 `onVoiceMode` is set. Without either, the empty field shows a disabled Send instead.

props.name: onVoiceMode
props.description:
The empty field's Voice action (Primary, recording icon): start voice mode, e.g. an AiVoiceConversation. Default:
 `onVoice`.

props.name: listening
props.description:
Figma State=Voice: the field is taking dictation. The prompt reads the locale's "Listening…" (Content/Placeholder)
 and the microphone becomes Stop (`onStopListening`); the Primary stays Voice.

props.name: busy
props.description: While the reply streams, the primary button becomes Stop.

props.name: value
props.description: The prompt text, controlled (pairs with `onValueChange`); leave it out to let the field keep its own.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial prompt text when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change of the prompt text (typing, dictation, a cleared field after Send): compose while typing reads it.

props.name: onAccept
props.description:
Tab accepts what the app proposes for the prompt (compose while typing: keep the guessed intent) and then moves
 focus as in any field, into the proposed UI when it is next in the tab order. Pass it only while there is
 something to accept.

props.name: onClear
props.description:
Escape clears the prompt and calls it (a preview to dismiss, a draft to drop). Pass it only while there is
 something to clear; without it Escape does nothing in the field.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the icon buttons it draws, by layer (`{ Submit: { level: "accent" }, Attach: { appearance: "main" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets onAttach / onVoice / onVoiceMode.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<form>` element.

components.name: AiChatBlock
components.description: Figma AI/Chat-Block/Pale (7140:115622): Say-Hi (44px logo + Heading/1) · Chat-Field · Chip/Normal suggestions (Medium, Secondary, Leading-Icon).

props.name: greeting
props.description: Say-Hi heading (the locale's "How can I help you today?" by default).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the greeting: 2 (default), or 1 when the block opens the page and its greeting is the page title (a home screen); only the tag changes, the style stays Heading/1.

props.name: logo
props.description: Say-Hi logo: an icon name or your own node (the Zen mark by default).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the suggestion chips, by label (`{ "Suggestion[Plan a trip]": { level: "primary" } }`), written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<section>` element.

components.name: AiChatThread
components.description: Conversation column (max 800, gap 24); the field docks at the bottom.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the conversation (the locale's "Conversation" by default).

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div role="log">` element.
